Every incoming SMS is checked against your active rules. A rule matches when the sender contains the sender filter and the text contains the text filter. Upper and lower case do not matter, and an empty filter matches everything. A filter can list several terms separated by commas; one of them is enough. Messages containing the \"does NOT contain\" filter are skipped, and rules with a time window only apply on the chosen days and times. Advanced users can switch a rule to regular expressions.\n\nMatching messages are sent as a new SMS to every recipient of the rule: a line with the original sender (can be turned off in the settings), the original text, followed by \"This is a forwarded message\".

• Sending: the phone is sending the message.
• Sent: the mobile network accepted the message. The app is waiting for the delivery report.
• Delivered: the carrier confirmed that the recipient's phone received the message.
• Not sent: the phone could not send the message, for example without network.
• Not delivered: the carrier reported that delivery failed.
• No delivery report after 24 h: sent, but never confirmed. Some carriers do not send delivery reports at all.
• Attempt 2, 3…: the message was resent from the history.
How many rules can I create?

As many as you like, there is no limit. If several rules match the same message, every recipient still gets it only once, even if they appear in several rules. The history shows which rule reached which recipient. On dual SIM phones, each rule can send from its own SIM; a recipient in several rules gets the message from the SIM of the first one.\n\nUse \"Test\" to check which rules a message would match without sending anything. Give rules a name so you can tell them apart in the history.

Every forward is a regular SMS sent from your SIM card, once per recipient. Long messages may be split into several SMS. Depending on your plan, your carrier may charge for each of them, especially abroad or for foreign numbers. Resending from the history also sends new SMS.\n\nThe daily limit in the settings (100 SMS by default) caps how many SMS are sent per day. Forwards beyond it are not sent, and you get a notification.

Everything happens on this phone. The app has no internet access and does not upload messages, rules or contacts.

Rules and the history (the latest 200 messages) are stored only in the app and are deleted when you uninstall it. Contact names are read from your address book when they are shown and are never stored.

Forwarded messages are sent through your carrier like any other SMS.
A message was not forwarded or arrived twice

• Check on Home that forwarding is on and a rule is active.
• Chat messages (RCS) are not SMS and are not visible to the app. Ask the sender to send a plain SMS.
• Exempt the app from battery optimization so it is not stopped in the background.
• After "Force stop", Android does not deliver messages to the app until you open it once.
• On dual SIM phones, choose a SIM in the rule, or a fixed SIM for SMS in the phone settings instead of "Ask every time".
• Check whether today's daily limit was reached.
• Messages that end with "This is a forwarded message" are never forwarded again, to prevent loops.
• If recipients get messages twice, another SMS forwarding app is probably active on this phone.
